subject: Gambit / Remy LeBeau
prompt:
Create a standalone portrait-format narrative fantasy painting of Gambit / Remy LeBeau, the fictional Marvel X-Men character, for a personal Kalistar illustration proposal.

A tall lean athletic adult man with tousled auburn-brown hair, distinctive dark eyes with red irises, angular expressive face and a small confident half-smile. Recognizable weathered brown longcoat with raised collar, muted magenta chest armor, deep navy fitted trousers and boots, fingerless gloves. Practical worn materials and credible anatomy rather than glossy superhero plastic. This is the comic character, not a live-action actor likeness.

He stands three-quarter toward the viewer at the end of a quiet rain-darkened stone quay, balanced with one foot slightly higher on a low step. His right hand holds a clear fan of three playing cards beside his face, with restrained violet-pink kinetic light along their edges and a few tiny sparks. His left hand holds one straight long metal staff planted on the ground, continuous shaft with a coherent grip and perspective. The staff stays straight and may extend beyond the image edge rather than bending. The cards are not being thrown. Wind lifts just one coat tail. He appears charming, alert and self-possessed, as though inviting a final wager.

Mandatory Kalistar art direction: richly painted narrative fantasy, visible angular brush strokes, layered pigment and broken painted color planes, sculpted expressive features, selective sharp edges on eyes and hands, broad quieter planes elsewhere. Tactile scuffed leather, softened cloth seams, weathered metal. Natural body proportions and readable hands. No photographic or celebrity likeness, no smooth 3D render, no anime, no flat comic outlines. The scene should feel painted by hand, intimate and lived-in.

Composition: vertical approximately 4:5, character dominant from boots to hair, face and card gesture central and readable in a collectible illustration window. Restrained background, just broad wet stone planes, a simple distant quay light and misty water, without intricate buildings or clutter. Cool dusk against warm reflected lamplight; subtle magenta card glow illuminates his fingers and cheek without obscuring them. Only Gambit in the frame. Illustration only, no card frame, captions, statistics, lettering, interface, logos or watermark.
